assembly_audit.boundary: Actual coaxial passages, continuous wall/seat witnesses, head seating, access with upper cap removed, integral roots, fixed-spindle retention, keyed rotor fit/torque witnesses and sampled rigid vertical insertions. Threads are major-diameter envelopes. Printed fits, key backlash, insertion under friction/compliance, screw standard selection, preload, stripping, stiffness and strength need physical qualification.

engineering_estimates.boundary: Starting dimensions and force-order checks only. Spring legs/anchors, real grades, friction, printed leaf behavior, wear and dynamic return require design review and physical measurement. No strength, fatigue, acoustic, retention or reliable-feed qualification.

intentional_connections.rotor: Drum/hub/travel pin form the lower rotor; RNA gear/input sleeve/click wheel/feed wheel form the upper rotor. A D-key couples the two, with separate assembly and torque witnesses.
intentional_connections.TPU: Neighboring nominal RNA cells, their base roots and clasp roots represent one continuous flexible strip.
intentional_connections.flexures: Connected click-leaf chords depict prescribed bending, not separate manufactured links.
intentional_connections.spring_studies: Coil reservation and terminal stubs represent one proposed deforming spring; their shared endpoints overlap intentionally.
intentional_connections.integral_roots: Lower-body/spindle and cover/detent-anchor features overlap and fuse to one solid each.
intentional_connections.fastener: Only bounded nominal thread envelopes overlap their pilots. Coaxial passages, conical seats, clamped stack and fixed washer shoulder are checked; thread strength and preload are unqualified.

validation_boundary: Focused actual bead/drum, actual rack/gear including shoulder bends, conservative continuous envelopes, central RNA captivity, reusable-clasp fit, native open/closed forward/reverse, cap feed/return, cam clearance, positive travel stops, actual screw passages/seats/wall sections, integral roots, keyed rotor fit/torque and sampled assembly insertion checks. TPU cells and flexure chords are prescribed deformation; native coupling omits physical key backlash and axial float. Spring volumes are space claims. No force, click acoustics, compliance, strain, snap retention, fatigue, manufacturing, hand-fit or physical-operation qualification.
physical_tests_still_required: RNA TPU bending, pitch stability, mesh friction and guide escape under hand loads
Clasp snap force, retention, peeling release and repeated-cycle fatigue
Closed-loop clasp travel, grip clearance and open-tail handling
Bidirectional detent force, audible click and long-term wear
Cap follower friction, axial bias and return springs, reliable one-step engagement and face-ramp return
End-of-feed force transmission and protection against pawl skip or damage under overload
Direct bead capture/retraction, wire pitch fixation, buckling and bend fatigue
Printed fits, fastening, material selection, assembly and durability
